name: held-text-reads-the-shell-words
description: Held text reads the words the shell parser reads in each run command, after the shell removes their quotes: a glob character stands for any text, each alternative of a brace expansion is a word of its own, a part quoted inside a word stays in it, and a word inside a command substitution is read too, so each file such a word may write is held, nothing it exports is reported, and the package has one note. A word whose written text is only separators and . names no file, and outside the file a command runs it makes no finding possible, so a file no word names is reported at the class certain.
